results.name: Flood in Rio Grande Do Sul State, Brazil
results.reason: Authorities in Brazil Rio Grande do Sul State declared a state of emergency on Thursday, 2 May 2024 after floods and mudslides caused by torrential rains left at least 30 people dead and 60 missing.Storm damage has affected nearly 150 municipalities, forcing over 15,000 people to flee from their homes. In some areas, the flood is so severe that entire communities have been completely cut off from road infrastructures and network.Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide initial rough estimation, flood extent and damage assessment emergency mapping
